TOWARDS MORNING I WAS POSSESSED BY A KIND OF NIGHTMARE; I FELT THE FIEND'S GRASP IN MY NECK AND COULD NOT FREE MYSELF FROM IT; GROANS AND CRIES RANG IN MY EARS. MY FATHER, WHO WAS WATCHING OVER ME, PERCEIVING MY RESTLESSNESS, AWOKE ME; THE DASHING WAVES WERE AROUND, THE CLOUDY SKY ABOVE, THE FIEND WAS NOT HERE: A SENSE OF SECURITY, A FEELING THAT A TRUCE WAS ESTABLISHED BETWEEN THE PRESENT HOUR AND THE IRRESISTIBLE, DISASTROUS FUTURE IMPARTED TO ME A KIND OF CALM FORGETFULNESS, OF WHICH THE HUMAN MIND IS BY ITS STRUCTURE PECULIARLY SUSCEPTIBLE. CHAPTER THE VOYAGE CAME TO AN END. WE LANDED, AND PROCEEDED TO PARIS. I SOON FOUND THAT I HAD OVERTAXED MY STRENGTH AND THAT I MUST REPOSE BEFORE I COULD CONTINUE MY JOURNEY. MY FATHER'S CARE AND ATTENTIONS WERE INDEFATIGABLE, BUT HE DID NOT KNOW THE ORIGIN OF MY SUFFERINGS AND SOUGHT ERRONEOUS METHODS TO REMEDY THE INCURABLE ILL. HE WISHED ME TO SEEK AMUSEMENT IN SOCIETY. I ABHORRED THE FACE OF MAN. OH, NOT ABHORRED! THEY WERE MY BRETHREN, MY FELLOW BEINGS, AND I FELT ATTRACTED EVEN TO THE MOST REPULSIVE AMONG THEM, AS TO CREATURES OF AN ANGELIC NATURE AND CELESTIAL MECHANISM. BUT I FELT THAT I HAD NO RIGHT TO SHARE THEIR INTERCOURSE. I HAD UNCHAINED AN ENEMY AMONG THEM WHOSE JOY IT WAS TO SHED THEIR BLOOD AND TO REVEL IN THEIR GROANS. HOW THEY WOULD, EACH AND ALL, ABHOR ME AND HUNT ME FROM THE WORLD DID THEY KNOW MY UNHALLOWED ACTS AND THE CRIMES WHICH HAD THEIR SOURCE IN ME! MY FATHER YIELDED AT LENGTH TO MY DESIRE TO AVOID SOCIETY AND STROVE BY VARIOUS ARGUMENTS TO BANISH MY DESPAIR. SOMETIMES HE THOUGHT THAT I FELT DEEPLY THE DEGRADATION OF BEING OBLIGED TO ANSWER A CHARGE OF MURDER, AND HE ENDEAVOURED TO PROVE TO ME THE FUTILITY OF PRIDE. ALAS! MY FATHER, SAID I, HOW LITTLE DO YOU KNOW ME. HUMAN BEINGS, THEIR FEELINGS AND PASSIONS, WOULD INDEED BE DEGRADED IF SUCH A WRETCH AS I FELT PRIDE. JUSTINE, POOR UNHAPPY JUSTINE, WAS AS INNOCENT AS I, AND SHE SUFFERED THE SAME CHARGE; SHE DIED FOR IT; AND I AM THE CAUSE OF THIS--…(+519)

COMARTS DORNING I MAS BOSSESSET JY A XINT OF NIGHCDARE; I FELC CHE FIENT'S GRASB IN DY NEPX ANT POULT NOC FREE DYSELF FROD IC; GROANS ANT PRIES RANG IN DY EARS. DY FACHER, MHO MAS MACPHING OVER DE, BERPEIVING DY RESCLESSNESS, AMOXE DE; CHE TASHING MAVES MERE AROUNT, CHE PLOUTY SXY AJOVE, CHE FIENT MAS NOC HERE: A SENSE OF SEPURICY, A FEELING CHAC A CRUPE MAS ESCAJLISHET JECMEEN CHE BRESENC HOUR ANT CHE IRRESISCIJLE, TISASCROUS FUCURE IDBARCET CO DE A XINT OF PALD FORGECFULNESS, OF MHIPH CHE HUDAN DINT IS JY ICS SCRUPCURE BEPULIARLY SUSPEBCIJLE. PHABCER CHE VOYAGE PADE CO AN ENT. ME LANTET, ANT BROPEETET CO BARIS. I SOON FOUNT CHAC I HAT OVERCAZET DY SCRENGCH ANT CHAC I DUSC REBOSE JEFORE I POULT PONCINUE DY QOURNEY. DY FACHER'S PARE ANT ACCENCIONS MERE INTEFACIGAJLE, JUC HE TIT NOC XNOM CHE ORIGIN OF DY SUFFERINGS ANT SOUGHC ERRONEOUS DECHOTS CO REDETY CHE INPURAJLE ILL. HE MISHET DE CO SEEX ADUSEDENC IN SOPIECY. I AJHORRET CHE FAPE OF DAN. OH, NOC AJHORRET! CHEY MERE DY JRECHREN, DY FELLOM JEINGS, ANT I FELC ACCRAPCET EVEN CO CHE DOSC REBULSIVE ADONG CHED, AS CO PREACURES OF AN ANGELIP NACURE ANT PELESCIAL DEPHANISD. JUC I FELC CHAC I HAT NO RIGHC CO SHARE CHEIR INCERPOURSE. I HAT UNPHAINET AN ENEDY ADONG CHED MHOSE QOY IC MAS CO SHET CHEIR JLOOT ANT CO REVEL IN CHEIR GROANS. HOM CHEY MOULT, EAPH ANT ALL, AJHOR DE ANT HUNC DE FROD CHE MORLT TIT CHEY XNOM DY UNHALLOMET APCS ANT CHE PRIDES MHIPH HAT CHEIR SOURPE IN DE! DY FACHER YIELTET AC LENGCH CO DY TESIRE CO AVOIT SOPIECY ANT SCROVE JY VARIOUS ARGUDENCS CO JANISH DY TESBAIR. SODECIDES HE CHOUGHC CHAC I FELC TEEBLY CHE TEGRATACION OF JEING OJLIGET CO ANSMER A PHARGE OF DURTER, ANT HE ENTEAVOURET CO BROVE CO DE CHE FUCILICY OF BRITE. ALAS! DY FACHER, SAIT I, HOM LICCLE TO YOU XNOM DE. HUDAN JEINGS, CHEIR FEELINGS ANT BASSIONS, MOULT INTEET JE TEGRATET IF SUPH A MRECPH AS I FELC BRITE. QUSCINE, BOOR UNHABBY QUSCINE, MAS AS INNOPENC AS I, ANT SHE SUFFERET CHE SADE PHARGE; SHE TIET FOR IC; ANT I AD CHE PAUSE OF CHIS--…(+519)
